data.description: The Modular Boat is the boat you build yourself, so the cost depends on your design. Build it with a [Boat Building Plan](/items/boat-building-plan) (20 wood, or 50 scrap at a Floating City [Boat Vendor](/world/boat-vendor)) and a [Boat Building Station](/items/boat-building-station) (200 wood, 1 tarp). A [Boat Hull](/building/boat-hull-square) piece costs 300 wood and 15 low grade, a Boat Floor 150 wood and 8 low grade. Decay starts after 24 hours and takes 12. Breaking one takes 21 C4 or 48 rockets.
